sections.heading: Breadcrumb
paragraphs: A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in a content hierarchy and links back to each parent level.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Breadcrumbs are secondary navigation. They show the user's current position in a hierarchy and give one-click access to every ancestor level.

sections.heading: Variants
paragraphs: Middle levels collapse behind a trigger when the trail exceeds maxItems.
Items pair an icon with their label.

sections.heading: When to use
paragraphs: •   To show the user's position within a content hierarchy.
•   To give quick, one-click navigation back to parent levels.

sections.heading: When not to use
paragraphs: •   As the primary navigation of the app.

sections.heading: Anatomy
paragraphs: •   ① Item (link) — a clickable ancestor level.
•   ② Separator — a decorative divider between items (chevron or slash).
•   ③ Collapse trigger (optional) — an ellipsis that reveals hidden middle items.
•   ④ Current page — the final item; the active location, not interactive.
Not shown: the optional leading icon on each item (Has icon) — see the Icon-based variant.

sections.heading: Alignment
paragraphs: Items and separators sit on one horizontal line, with equal spacing around each separator. Use one separator style for the whole trail.

sections.heading: Placement
paragraphs: The trail never wraps and never causes horizontal page scroll. On small screens, collapse it to the root and the current page.
Show the current page as plain, non-interactive text.
Don't style the current page as a link — it implies it's still clickable.
Use one separator style per trail.
Don't mix separator styles within one trail.
Collapse the middle of deep trails, keeping the root and current page.
Don't show many deep levels without collapsing the middle.

sections.heading: Main elements
paragraphs: •   Each item except the last names and links to its parent level.
•   Long labels truncate with an ellipsis; the full label stays available in a tooltip.
•   The final item names the page the user is on.

sections.heading: Overflow content
paragraphs: When the trail has more items than maxItems, the middle items collapse behind the ellipsis trigger. The root and the current page always stay visible.

sections.heading: States
paragraphs: •   Link — Default, Hover (underline), Focused (3px focus ring) and Disabled (rare: an ancestor with no valid target).
•   Collapse trigger — Default, Hover and Focused.
See the Style tab for how each state looks.

sections.heading: Interactions
paragraphs: Clicking a link goes to that level. Clicking the collapse trigger reveals the hidden items. The current page and separators do nothing.
Moves focus to the next link, left to right
The current page and separators are skipped. Full keyboard details are on the Accessibility tab.

sections.heading: Color
paragraphs: Swatches are bound to the live tokens.

sections.heading: Variants & states
paragraphs: BreadcrumbItem has 8 variants: Link (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled), Current (Default) and Collapse (Default, Hover, Focused). Separator has 2 (Slash, Chevron).

sections.heading: Breadcrumb
paragraphs: A breadcrumb shows where the current page sits in a content hierarchy and links back to each parent level.

sections.heading: What the design system provides
paragraphs: •   A Focused state with a 3px ring on links and the collapse trigger.
•   Hover adds an underline, so the link affordance doesn't rely on color alone.
•   The current page is styled differently from links (text/primary, no underline).
•   Items are 24px tall — meeting the 24×24px AA target minimum (WCAG 2.5.8).

sections.heading: Development considerations
paragraphs: •   Wrap the trail in a <nav> landmark with aria-label="Breadcrumb", containing an ordered list (<ol>).
•   Each ancestor is an <a> inside an <li>.
•   The current page is not a link and carries aria-current="page".
•   Separators are decorative: aria-hidden="true", not focusable, not clickable.
•   The collapse trigger is keyboard-operable and reveals the hidden items.
•   Truncated labels keep their full text available via a title or tooltip.

sections.heading: Keyboard interactions
paragraphs: Moves focus to the next link, left to right
Moves focus to the previous link

sections.heading: Design recommendations
paragraphs: Automated contrast check — WCAG 2.x relative luminance (sRGB), against the page surface (surface/bg/default), for every theme combination. Minimums: 4.5:1 for labels, 3:1 for separators, icons, the focus ring and disabled text (house rule TKN-005). Note: project-a / light is measured against the current surface/bg/default, which resolves to blue because of the gray/50 token.

sections.heading: Target size
paragraphs: Items and the collapse trigger are 24px tall, meeting the AA minimum but below the 44×44px touch target in the component rules — pad the hit area on touch screens.
